entries.name: Adaptability
entries.definition: The capacity to adjust to new conditions, tasks or environments.

entries.name: Attention to detail
entries.definition: Being careful about small details and thorough in checking that work is accurate and complete.

entries.name: Causal reasoning
entries.definition: Distinguishing prediction from intervention and causal explanation.

entries.name: Emotional stability
entries.definition: The tendency to stay calm and even-tempered under pressure.

entries.name: Goal-oriented
entries.definition: A tendency to set clear objectives and keep working steadily toward reaching them.

entries.name: Ingenuity
entries.definition: The quality of being clever and inventive, especially in finding new ways to solve problems.

entries.name: Patience
entries.definition: The capacity to stay calm and keep working or waiting without annoyance when things are slow, difficult or repetitive.

entries.name: Quick learning
entries.definition: The ability to take in and apply new information, methods or tools in a short time.

entries.name: Resilience
entries.definition: The capacity to keep functioning and recover after setbacks, stress or hardship.

entries.name: Results-oriented
entries.definition: A tendency to focus on achieving measurable outcomes and to judge work by what it produces.

entries.name: Self-confidence
entries.definition: Trust in one's own abilities and judgment, shown by acting and speaking without undue doubt.

entries.name: Self-starter
entries.definition: Taking the initiative to begin and carry out work without being told or closely supervised.

entries.name: Spatial-temporal reasoning
entries.definition: The ability to understand and mentally work with how objects and events are arranged in space and change over time.
